requirements.title: A C descriptor is a CFI_cdesc_t structure for describing Fortran data objects from C
requirements.definition: A C descriptor is a C structure of type CFI_cdesc_t, defined in ISO_Fortran_binding.h, that together with the standard library-function prototypes provides a means for describing and manipulating Fortran data objects from within a C function.

pending.c-descriptor-cfi-cdesc-t-structure: Compile a C companion including ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declare a CFI_cdesc_t pointer initialized to a nonnull CFI_CDESC_T(1) object cast, and call a helper that accepts only CFI_cdesc_t *; mutate the helper parameter to an unrelated struct pointer.
pending.c-descriptor-describes-fortran-data-from: Use a Fortran caller passing a rank-one noninteroperable dummy to a C function with a CFI_cdesc_t * formal; the C function checks rank one, nonnull base_addr, positive elem_len, and dim[0].extent three for a three-element actual initialized to distinct values, then mutates the expected rank.
pending.c-descriptor-defined-in-iso-fortran-bind: Build the same C companion without any local declaration of CFI_cdesc_t; the include alone supplies the type and CFI_CDESC_T macro, with mutation removing the include.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future mixed C/Fortran fixtures compile a C translation unit with the processor ISO_Fortran_binding.h supplied by the harness and assert only portable properties: required type and member presence, required member ordering, macro availability, integer-constant expression usability, sign and distinctness relations fixed by the text, CFI_VERSION equality inside processor-created descriptors, descriptor rank/extent/lower-bound/stride relations, and named error-code results. Numeric macro values, descriptor storage addresses, unsupported C type availability, extra processor extension codes, line-number effects, IOMSG text, and allocation-failure occurrence are not hard-coded.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. The existing C-interoperability harness supports separate Fortran and C build steps, processor-header staging via fortran_binding_header, and compiler-header provenance checks; existing descriptor-related fixtures exercise that harness for other catalogues but are not rebound here. Unnumbered program restrictions are recorded without diagnostic facets.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, and 16 where already catalogued for source form, declarations, intrinsic types and kinds, arrays, execution, mixed-language harnesses, procedure interfaces, ISO_C_BINDING constants, and exact inquiry helpers. Unregistered dependencies retained: earlier Clause 18 interoperability rules, later 18.5.5 descriptor functions, clause 19 storage and association terms, and the C standard library headers named or included by ISO_Fortran_binding.h.

accounting.rationale: Defines C descriptor, its CFI_cdesc_t structure type, header source, and role for C manipulation of Fortran data objects.
